tools.name: get_project_status
tools.description: Where a paid order is in production. Returns the studio stage (new, brief_received, in_production, review, delivered) plus paid/package/deposit. PII-free; pass the stripe_session_id from create_checkout/get_order.

tools.name: get_inquiry_status
tools.description: Where a custom inquiry stands: awaiting_confirmation (customer hasn't clicked the emailed link yet) or confirmed with the studio stage (new, replied, proposal_sent, won, closed). PII-free; pass the inquiry_id returned by submit_custom_inquiry.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_offers, create_upload_url, submit_custom_inquiry, get_project_status · Private data: get_order, submit_brief, create_upload_url · Public sink: submit_brief, create_upload_url, submit_custom_inquiry.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_offers, create_upload_url, submit_custom_inquiry, get_project_status · Private data: get_order, submit_brief, create_upload_url · Public sink: submit_brief, create_upload_url, submit_custom_inquiry

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
